data.name: Conditioning
data.description: A skirmisher becomes more resistant to mental and physical threats that are commonly employed by his enemies or often encountered in the terrain in which he operates. The skirmisher must choose one specialization, gaining a +%1 bonus on saving throws of the appropriate type.|SkirmisherConditioningBonus
